title: Sorry, Coach
explanation: The respectful, short tone, and the greeting to Coach Mensah, come from naming a writer and a reader. That is the Who's Cooking, Who's Eating recipe, Station 02.
output:
Dear Coach Mensah,

I am sorry I missed practice on Tuesday. I had a bad cold, and I did not want to pass it on to the team. I will be there on Thursday, ready to work hard.

Thank you,
Sam

options.prompt: You are Sam, a 12-year-old on the football team. Your reader is Coach Mensah. Write a short, respectful note saying sorry for missing Tuesday's practice because of a cold.
Write a funny note about missing practice.
You are a lawyer. Write a formal letter about a missed practice.
